summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private helper, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run or committed. Lines are under 120 columns, but black and flake8 were not available, so formatting and the tests are unverified.
